plan_name: Arogya Sanjeevani Policy, Bajaj General Insurance Limited (Group)

room_rent.note: If room taken at higher rate, all other expenses (except medicines) reimbursed proportionately

icu.note: ICU/ICCU charges capped at 5% of SI per day subject to ₹10,000 maximum

copayment.note: Mandatory 5% co-payment applies to every admissible claim amount

sub_limits.display: Cataract capped; modern treatments at 50% SI
sub_limits.note: Cataract: 25% of SI or ₹40,000 per eye per year (whichever lower); listed modern treatments (robotic surgery etc.) capped at 50% of SI

initial_waiting.note: Waived for accidents; not applicable if continuously covered for more than 12 months

ped_waiting.note: Reducible via portability/migration credit from prior continuous coverage

specific_disease_waiting.note: 24-month list includes cataract, hernia, hydrocele, piles, varicose veins etc.; 36-month list includes joint replacement, age-related osteoarthritis

maternity.note: Maternity expenses explicitly excluded (Excl18); ectopic pregnancy is covered

cumulative_bonus.note: 5% added per claim-free year; reduced at same rate if claim made; max 50% of SI

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in the policy wording

post_hosp.note: From date of discharge, for same condition

day_care.note: Listed day-care treatments covered; Annexure I referenced

domiciliary.note: Section 7.18 explicitly excludes domiciliary hospitalisation and OPD treatment

ayush.note: Inpatient AYUSH treatment covered up to full sum insured in recognised AYUSH hospitals

organ_donor.note: No mention of organ donor expense cover in the policy wording

ambulance.note: Road ambulance capped at ₹2,000 per hospitalisation

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments (robotic surgery, stereotactic radio surgery, stem cell therapy etc.) covered up to 50% of SI

consumables.note: Extensive List I of non-medical/consumable items explicitly excluded (gloves, masks, diapers etc.)

global_cover.note: Section 10.7 restricts all treatment to India only; overseas treatment explicitly excluded (7.19)

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months no claim contestable except fraud and permanent exclusions

grace_period.note: 15 days for monthly premium mode; 30 days for all other modes

free_look.note: Applicable only at inception, not on renewal or porting

portability.note: IRDAI portability norms apply; waiting period credit from prior continuous coverage

notable_exclusions.display: Domiciliary & OPD, maternity, infertility/IVF, overseas treatment, refractive error <7.5D, obesity surgery (conditional)

optional_riders.note: No optional riders or add-ons described in the policy wording
